svg.title: Harness map: developer-agents layer
svg.desc: Developer-agents harness. Lossless on the left, The Collaborator on the right, artifacts grouped by category. Each line joins a pair and is labelled shared, similar, or missing on their side. Three Lossless pieces (a root instruction file, CI and a changelog convention) have no counterpart on their side; the tree machinery (Stow-linked skills, the Chroma corpus, Spec Kit) has none either, and needs none.
